distinctConcepts: Precompute Category separates Rendered Effects from Titles and Matte Keys. Effect Category names a catalogue group such as Blend, Timewarp, Image or Sapphire Transitions. These are different fields.

Media Composer knows category/group information through its effect registrations and shipped registry. That knowledge is associated with an effect identifier/name in the application; it is not proof that a selected MDB precompute master directly records its original producer category.

Current MediaMuster extracts an effect-looking token from the selected precompute Clip Name and looks it up in a compiled catalogue. This is useful inferred naming because Clip Names are editable. It is not equivalent to reading a verified recorded effect ID from the MDB.

knownIdentityProperties: OMFI:FXPS:attrEffectID and OMFI:FXPS:attrEffectIDLen, offsets+0x1658/+0x1660. These are effect identity/property payload routes, not a proven selected-master palette category field.
boundedNativeComponentRoute: The verified AComponent::Get path0x1482e8..308 reads CPNT:EffectID into the component optional effect-ID storage through its string reader and SetEffectIDHdl.

ATrackEffect::Get at0x1ef700..720 obtains its component effect-ID through virtual+0x2f0 and passes the identifier string to AEffectLibrary::FindEffect. ATrackEffect::GetEffect at0x1f3aac..acc has the same identifier-based lookup boundary.

The ATrackEffect vtable slot+0x2f0 resolves to ATrackGroup::GetEffectID0x1eb97c, which forwards to AComponent::GetEffectID0x1492f8. This is an identifier lookup route, not a call to parse a precompute Clip Name.

This is a component identity, not automatically the selected precompute master generating effect or palette category.

currentFlow: OMF contributes already-qualified selected-master ClipName and Type facts. The field is not a new OMF text/property decoder: shared post-selection projection derives it from final selected ClipName only when selectedTypeisPrecompute and selected name observation exists. No descriptor/source/master-effectgraph is read for this label.

selectEffectMetadata excludes prior interpretations from its locator, calls AvidEffects::lookup once for Effect+EffectCategory+legacySequence per derivation pass, copies selected name source/provenance into derived observations and selects outputs. Matching/selectMetadata can invoke derivation more than once; do not claim one call per entire current scan or one raw OMF-specific parser call.

The existing resolver builds one function-local static immutable index lazily from compiled UTF8 catalogue strings and English/localizedmangled keys; exact QString/QHash lookup is case sensitive. Explicit3DWarp compatibility alias is already present. This is a current strength, not a new Bella gain.

Existing parser recognizes final +decimalInteger and commaInteger[.new.Integer...] suffix forms, validates complete decimal ranges, preserves commas inside preceding sequence text and retains malformed/overflowing suffix text. Missingname/empty/unrecognizedselectedname cannot establish an effect identifier.

Known key selects first catalogue English display name and all distinct matching categories in catalogue row order joined with space/slash/space. Unknown token keeps token as Effect and lowercaseunknown category. The mangle helper converts only spaces/colons to underscores; no arbitrarycasefold, fuzzy matching or stripped punctuation.

Current row stores effect/category/sequence QStrings. For Precompute, effectCategoryDisplay returns storedcategory or lowercaseunknown; Media/UnknownTypeblank. Table/CSV use same shared labels; optionalsearch/filter and case-insensitive display sorting consume them. UnknownEffectCategory is intentionally different from prior blankUnavailable Type/PrecomputeCategory decisions.

Optionalcolumns, exportdetails,search/filter use feature settings, but the shared derivation function has no internal optionalflag guard. Existing title/matte filter outline skips the EffectCategory subgroup while rendered branches use it; preserve this UI contract rather than redesigning category hierarchy here.

Unknown/absent derived label alone does not request media read. Current generic unresolved derived-label conflict branch can requestheader. Bella final selected-name derivation does not need another source read merely for EffectCategory; general opening decisions remain outside scope.
proposedMinimalBella: Preserve existing compiledcatalogue, token parser and lookup output unchanged. Decode OMF ownmastername using accepted owner/text rules and independentType; derive after scannerfinalselection, not from whichever intermediate name happens to match catalogue.

For confirmedPrecompute and requestedretaineddetails, one shared existing lookup supplies Effect+EffectCategory. Reuse result temporarily for rows sharing selectedmaster/name; deriveagain if selectedinputschange. MissingPrecomputeCategorydoesnotblockEffectCategory, and a knownname cannot establishType/categoryparent.

Retain ownedQString outputs with normalQtsharing and necessaryderivedcontext. No permanent every-namecache, giantcategoryenum, custominterner, per-columnparser/class or rawsource/historygraph. Keep the alreadysharedlazy index.

Preserve exactcase,localizedandcompatibilityaliases, numeric-suffixfailure behavior and all ambiguouscategories in originalorder. Preserve lowercaseunknown for unavailable/unmatchedPrecomputeEffectCategory in table/export/filter; ordinaryMedia/UnknownTypeblank.

Discard legacySequence and unnecessaryinstance/matched outputs after transientlookup. Do not store/exportEffectSequence or reintroduce its column. Existing parser can still use sequence boundary toidentifyEffecttoken without retainingSequenceinBellaresults.

No binaryeffectgraph/parameter/pluginidentity reconstruction, newencoding guess, importattribute/mediaopen, newsourcepriority, PrecomputeType/category rewrite or BinFilter change. Simpler integration/lifetimes are design choices, with no measured runtimegain.

"""Curate pending shared Effect Category integration for OMF; no media/app use."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/martymclean/Developer/MediaMuster')
CACHE = {}
verified, unavailable, captures = {}, [], {}


def sha(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if str(p) not in CACHE:
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with p.open('rb') as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
                h.update(block)
        CACHE[str(p)] = h.hexdigest()
    return CACHE[str(p)]


def record(path):
    p = Path(path)
    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(p)}


def check(path, expected, context):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.is_absolute():
        p = ROOT / p
    if not p.is_file():
        unavailable.append({'path': str(p), 'expectedSha256': expected, 'context': context})
        return
    actual = sha(p)
    assert actual == expected, (str(p), expected, actual, context)
    verified[str(p)] = {'bytes': p.stat().st_size, 'sha256': actual}
    if str(p).startswith('/private/tmp/') and p.suffix == '.txt' and p.stat().st_size <= 200000:
        captures[str(p)] = {'sha256': actual, 'text': p.read_text()}


def walk(value, context):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for pk, hk in [('path', 'sha256'), ('artifact', 'artifactSha256'),
                       ('resolvedArtifact', 'resolvedArtifactSha256'),
                       ('metadataSource', 'metadataSourceSha256'), ('classBlockPath', 'classBlockSha256')]:
            if isinstance(value.get(pk), str) and isinstance(value.get(hk), str):
                check(value[pk], value[hk], context)
        for key, child in value.items():
            if context == 'current' and key == 'sourceAnchors':
                continue
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(key))
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            walk(child, context + '/' + str(index))


expected_receipts = {
    'mc': '08328c91d65cded60c27f38afd299f38a34e61e7290196bfa01451af2c9fc7d8',
    'mdvx': '907b72f7219236dccdcbe928d9afe813f8ba45af2e9486916b8c2a23aa9c917e',
    'current': '23e7af82c0bd291c3893082ece5ddfa20bb30897d7276284dcf9f9b4122d4b9c',
}
receipts, receipt_files = {}, {}
for who, expected in expected_receipts.items():
    p = Path(f'/private/tmp/bella-omf-effect-category-{who}-20261025/findings.json')
    assert sha(p) == expected
    receipts[who] = json.loads(p.read_text())
    receipt_files[who] = record(p)
    walk(receipts[who], who)

current = receipts['current']
assert len(current['sourceInputs']) == 17 and len(current['sourceAnchors']) == 25
for source in current['sourceInputs']:
    p = Path(source['path'])
    relative = str(p.relative_to(ROOT))
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + relative], cwd=ROOT) == p.read_bytes()
for anchor in current['sourceAnchors']:
    lines = Path(anchor['path']).read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
    text = ''.join(lines[anchor['startLine'] - 1:anchor['endLine']])
    assert text == anchor['text']
    assert hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() == anchor['sha256']

mdvx = receipts['mdvx']
ranges, label_checks = [], []
with Path(mdvx['binary']['path']).open('rb') as stream:
    for method in mdvx['reusedFunctions']:
        stream.seek(method['binaryOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(method['codeBytes'])
        assert len(raw) == method['codeBytes']
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == method['codeSha256']
        ranges.append({k: method[k] for k in ['symbol', 'binaryOffset', 'codeBytes', 'codeSha256']})
    table = mdvx['reverifiedUsageData']
    stream.seek(table['tableFileOffset'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(stream.read(table['bytes'])).hexdigest() == table['sha256']
    for entry in table['labels']:
        stream.seek(entry['cfStringFileOffset'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(stream.read(32)).hexdigest() == entry['cfStringBytesSha256']
        stream.seek(entry['charactersFileOffset'])
        raw = stream.read(entry['charactersBytes'])
        assert raw == entry['text'].encode('ascii')
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == entry['charactersSha256']
        label_checks.append({'usageCode': entry['usageCode'], 'text': entry['text']})
assert len(ranges) == 14 and len(label_checks) == 15
assert receipts['mc']['method']['freshDisassembly'] is False
assert len(receipts['mc']['extantRawFreshlyHashed']) == 7

approval_path = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-precompute-category-plan-2026-10-25.json'
approval = json.loads(approval_path.read_text())
research = approval['researchAtApproval']
check(research['path'], research['sha256'], 'precomputeCategoryApproval/research')
type_path = ROOT / 'Project Bella/evidence/omf-type-2026-10-25.json'
type_research = json.loads(type_path.read_text())
examples = current['reusedActualMetadata']['examples']
assert len(examples) == 5
for example in examples:
    assert example['selectedMasterUsage'] == 7 and example['effectCategoryApplicable'] is False
    assert example['categoryDisplayUnderCurrentRule'] == ''
    previous = next(e for e in type_research['reusedOwnMetadata']['examples'] if e['path'] == example['path'])
    assert previous['selectedMasterObject'] == example['masterObject']
    assert previous['masterUsage'] == example['selectedMasterUsage']

historical = [v for v in unavailable if v['context'].startswith('mc/historicalRawAvailability/')]
fresh_unavailable = [v for v in unavailable if v not in historical]
assert not fresh_unavailable, fresh_unavailable

rules = {

    'ambiguity': 'Keep every distinct matching category in existing catalogue order joined by / with existing spaces. Preserve current English first-match Effect naming and raw unknown token behaviour, without new approximate normalization.',
    'display': 'ConfirmedPrecompute unknown/unavailable EffectCategory remains lowercaseunknown at table/export/search/filter. Media/unknownType blank. Accepted blank Type/PrecomputeCategory rules do not silently alter this field. Known Type/name need no successful parent category; inferred category never establishes Type/parent.',
    'minimalIntegration': 'Common source-independent value derivation outside OMF byte parser when optional effect details requested. Current common function has no internal optional guard and can run more than once during matching; do not call gating or one-index a measured new gain. Reuse per selected master/name input during processing, rederive if selectedType/name changes, no permanent every-name cache.',
    'retention': 'Owned QString EffectCategory and companion Effect plus necessary compact derived context; normalQt sharing. No full category enum/interner/separate output histories/sourcegraph/newdependency/class-per-column. Legacy Hit.sequence can be transient but is discarded from Bella stored rows/export; suffix-boundary rules remain.',
    'otherDecisions': 'No extra media read, header opening or new source priority/scheduling decision. PrecomputeCategory/Type/Compression and excludedEffectSequence remain intact. Final priorities/readtriggers/general OMF damage later; no measured speed/memory/reliability gain.',
    'evidenceBoundary': 'Five saved ordinaryMedia masters7 are inapplicable; zero genuinephysicalOMFPrecompute EffectCategory specimen claimed. Source/catalogue examples and pure/model/MXF authored controls inspected only, no new lookup execution or liveapp comparison.',
}
out = {
    'schemaVersion': 1, 'date': '2026-10-25', 'timezone': 'Australia/Sydney',
    'status': rules['status'],
    'currentHead': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
